prompt_text:
Match this appearance phrase against ALL anonymous person tiles in the image(s): "the person with long light brown hair wearing a dark brown short-sleeved dress with a flared skirt"
Every labeled tile is one different person from the same video; its two crops are held-out views. Labels and tile order do not reveal the intended target. A phrase may match none, one, or several people. Include ALL people who visibly satisfy the whole phrase in matches. Include in uncertain any plausible person for whom the views do not resolve an attribute, instead of assuming that person is a non-match. Do not pick a best match when several fit. A location or action does not distinguish appearance. Omitted labels mean clear non-matches.
Return {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"brief visual explanation"}. Valid labels: ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P08", "P09"].

message.content: {"matches":["P01","P02","P03","P04","P05","P06","P07","P08","P09"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"All individuals in the image tiles are wearing identical dark brown short-sleeved dresses with flared skirts. All appear to have long light brown hair, as visible in the various poses and angles across the crops. There is no visual evidence to distinguish any person as not matching the description, and all tiles show the same outfit and hair color/length. Therefore, all labeled persons satisfy the appearance phrase."}
